sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_tiket_open FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.status = 'open' AND c.status = 'active'

question: list pelanggan yg tiketnya masih belum selesai, cukup nama dan email
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name, c.email FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress')

question: Berapa sales dari tim Account-Management yang pernah menutup deal won?
sql: SELECT uniqExact(d.rep_id) AS jumlah_sales FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND r.team = 'Account-Management'

question: jumlah aktivitas per tim sales
sql: SELECT r.team, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team

question: Tampilkan jumlah tiket urgent dan jumlah tiket total untuk setiap perusahaan, hanya perusahaan dengan minimal 1 tiket urgent
sql: SELECT c.company, count() AS jumlah_tiket, countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') AS jumlah_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.company HAVING jumlah_urgent >= 1 ORDER BY jumlah_urgent DESC

question: omset per sales per bulan tahun ini untuk tim Inbound, tampilkan id dan nama sales
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND r.team = 'Inbound' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan, r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY bulan, total_omset DESC

question: jumlah pelanggan active per sales yang punya deal won
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, uniqExact(d.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan_active FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'active') GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan_active DESC

question: Pelanggan mana yang total omset-nya di atas rata-rata omset semua pelanggan? tampilkan omsetnya
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING total_omset > (SELECT avg(cust_omset.total) FROM (SELECT sum(d2.value) AS total FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d2.customer_id) AS cust_omset) ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Sales dengan jumlah deal won di atas rata-rata semua sales, sertakan jumlahnya
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING jumlah_won > (SELECT avg(rep_won.jumlah) FROM (SELECT count() AS jumlah FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d2.rep_id) AS rep_won)

question: Berapa rata-rata omset per pelanggan untuk tiap segmen? (hanya pelanggan yang punya deal won)
sql: SELECT cust_omset.segment, round(avg(cust_omset.total_omset), 2) AS rata_omset_per_pelanggan FROM (SELECT c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.segment AS segment, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.segment) AS cust_omset GROUP BY cust_omset.segment

question: Rata-rata jumlah deal won per sales di tiap tim
sql: SELECT rep_won.team, round(avg(rep_won.jumlah_won), 2) AS rata_won_per_sales FROM (SELECT r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.team AS team, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.team) AS rep_won GROUP BY rep_won.team

question: Pelanggan yang tiket urgent-nya lebih dari 1 dan sekaligus punya deal pipeline, tampilkan jumlah tiket urgent
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_urgent > 1 ORDER BY jumlah_urgent DESC

question: Per segmen: jumlah pelanggan, jumlah pelanggan yang punya deal won (bukan jumlah deal)
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan, countIf(won_agg.customer_id != '') AS pelanggan_dengan_won FROM customers AS c FINAL LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS won_agg ON c.customer_id = won_agg.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: Tampilkan 5 pelanggan dengan rasio tiket urgent tertinggi (minimal 5 tiket), sertakan rasionya
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, round(countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') / count(), 2) AS rasio_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING count() >= 5 ORDER BY rasio_urgent DESC LIMIT 5

question: Perbandingan jumlah tiket per bulan antara pelanggan Enterprise dan SMB sepanjang tahun ini
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, countIf(c.segment = 'Enterprise') AS tiket_enterprise, countIf(c.segment = 'SMB') AS tiket_smb FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Omset bulan ini vs bulan lalu untuk setiap sales, tampilkan id dan nama
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())) AS omset_bulan_ini, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today())) AS omset_bulan_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name

question: Tim sales mana yang rata-rata nilai deal won-nya melebihi rata-rata nilai deal won seluruh perusahaan?
sql: SELECT r.team, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_nilai_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team HAVING avg(d.value) > (SELECT avg(d2.value) FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won')

question: Berapa persen deal won yang dipegang tiap wilayah sales terhadap seluruh deal won? (rasio 0-1)
sql: SELECT r.region, round(count() / (SELECT count() FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won'), 2) AS porsi_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.region

question: pelanggan yg punya tiket urgent tapi nggak pernah ikut demo, plus jumlah tiket urgentnya
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_tiket_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'demo') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY jumlah_tiket_urgent DESC

question: Total omset, jumlah deal won, dan rata-rata nilai deal won per segmen pelanggan
sql: SELECT c.segment, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, count() AS jumlah_won, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_nilai_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment

question: Per perusahaan, jumlah deal berjalan dan nilai forecast-nya, hanya yang forecast di atas 1 juta
sql: SELECT c.company, count() AS jumlah_deal_pipeline, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY c.company HAVING forecast > 1000000 ORDER BY forecast DESC

question: Pelanggan dengan hari terakhir aktivitas paling lama (belum dihubungi paling lama), 10 teratas
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, max(a.timestamp) AS aktivitas_terakhir FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY aktivitas_terakhir ASC LIMIT 10

question: Sales dengan selisih hari rata-rata closing deal won paling cepat, 5 teratas, minimal 5 deal won
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(avg(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date)), 2) AS rata_hari_closing FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING count() >= 5 ORDER BY rata_hari_closing ASC LIMIT 5

question: Per tier pelanggan, jumlah tiket yang sudah resolved dan yang masih terbuka
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, countIf(t.status = 'resolved') AS jumlah_resolved, countIf(t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) AS jumlah_terbuka FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY tier

question: Pelanggan yang punya deal lost dalam 6 bulan terakhir tapi tidak punya deal won pada periode yang sama
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.closed_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 6) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING countIf(d.stage = 'lost') > 0 AND countIf(d.stage = 'won') = 0

question: Sales yang tidak punya aktivitas meeting maupun demo dalam 7 hari terakhir
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING countIf(a.type IN ('meeting','demo') AND a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 7)) = 0

question: berapa rata-rata jumlah tiket per pelanggan untuk tiap segmen, termasuk pelanggan tanpa tiket
sql: SELECT cust_tiket.segment, round(avg(cust_tiket.jumlah_tiket), 2) AS rata_tiket_per_pelanggan FROM (SELECT c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.segment AS segment, countIf(t.ticket_id != '') AS jumlah_tiket FROM customers AS c FINAL LEFT JOIN support_tickets AS t FINAL ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.segment) AS cust_tiket GROUP BY cust_tiket.segment

question: Top 5 pelanggan berdasarkan nilai deal won terbesar dalam satu deal, tampilkan nilai deal itu
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, max(d.value) AS deal_won_terbesar FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY deal_won_terbesar DESC LIMIT 5

question: Tiap hari dalam seminggu, jumlah aktivitas tim Inbound dan tim Outbound-Enterprise berdampingan
sql: SELECT toDayOfWeek(a.timestamp) AS hari, countIf(r.team = 'Inbound') AS aktivitas_inbound, countIf(r.team = 'Outbound-Enterprise') AS aktivitas_outbound FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY hari ORDER BY hari

question: Pelanggan yang tiket terbarunya masih terbuka (tampilkan tanggal tiket terakhirnya)
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, max(t.created_at) AS tiket_terakhir FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING argMax(t.status, t.created_at) IN ('open','in_progress') ORDER BY tiket_terakhir DESC

question: Pelanggan yang punya lebih dari 10 aktivitas tapi belum punya deal won, tampilkan jumlah aktivitasnya
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_aktivitas > 10 ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Sales mana yang punya deal lost lebih dari 5 tahun ini tetapi aktivitas negatifnya kurang dari 300? sertakan jumlah lost-nya
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'lost' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) AND r.rep_id IN (SELECT a.rep_id FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.rep_id HAVING countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative') < 300) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING jumlah_lost > 5

question: Pelanggan dengan jumlah tiket di atas rata-rata jumlah tiket per pelanggan, sertakan jumlahnya
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_tiket > (SELECT avg(cust_tiket.jumlah) FROM (SELECT count() AS jumlah FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS cust_tiket) ORDER BY jumlah_tiket DESC

question: Perusahaan dengan lebih dari satu pelanggan sekaligus punya deal won, tampilkan jumlah pelanggan berbedanya
sql: SELECT c.company, uniqExact(d.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.company HAVING jumlah_pelanggan_won > 1 ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan_won DESC

question: Sales yang total menit aktivitasnya di atas rata-rata semua sales, tampilkan total menitnya
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_menit FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING total_menit > (SELECT avg(rep_menit.total) FROM (SELECT sum(a2.duration_minutes) AS total FROM activities AS a2 GROUP BY a2.rep_id) AS rep_menit) ORDER BY total_menit DESC

question: Kasih liat pelanggan yang tiketnya paling lama selesai (rata-rata) per segmen, 1 pelanggan teratas tiap segmen
sql: SELECT x.segment, x.customer_id, x.name, x.rata_jam FROM (SELECT c.segment AS segment, c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_jam, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY avg(t.resolution_time_hours) DESC) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.resolution_time_hours IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.segment, c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Per wilayah pelanggan, jumlah deal won dan total omset, hanya wilayah dengan omset di atas 100 juta
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, count() AS jumlah_won, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY wilayah HAVING total_omset > 100000000 ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: sales yg pernah menangani pelanggan churned, urut dari yang paling banyak pelanggan churned-nya, tampilkan jumlah pelanggan churned uniknya
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, uniqExact(d.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan_churned FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned') GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan_churned DESC

question: Berapa persen tiket yang dibuat pelanggan Enterprise dibanding semua tiket, per bulan tahun ini? (rasio 0-1)
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, round(countIf(c.segment = 'Enterprise') / count(), 2) AS rasio_enterprise FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: berapa deal pipeline yg dipegang sales tim Outbound-Enterprise?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_deal_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND r.team = 'Outbound-Enterprise'

question: Per tier pelanggan, tampilkan jumlah pelanggan unik yang punya deal won dan total omsetnya
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, uniqExact(d.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY tier

question: Sales mana yang meeting-nya lebih banyak dari demo-nya? sertakan jumlah keduanya
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, countIf(a.type = 'meeting') AS jumlah_meeting, countIf(a.type = 'demo') AS jumlah_demo FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING jumlah_meeting > jumlah_demo

question: Pelanggan active yang tiket urgent-nya belum selesai dan jumlah aktivitas negatifnya lebih dari 5
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative') AS jumlah_negatif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_negatif > 5 ORDER BY jumlah_negatif DESC

question: Tiap segmen, deal pipeline yang paling besar nilainya beserta nilainya
sql: SELECT c.segment, max(d.value) AS pipeline_terbesar FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY c.segment

question: Wilayah sales mana yang rata-rata durasi aktivitasnya paling lama, dan berapa rata-ratanya?
sql: SELECT r.region, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY rata_durasi DESC LIMIT 1

question: pelanggan Enterprise dgn jumlah deal won terbanyak per wilayah pelanggan, 1 teratas tiap wilayah
sql: SELECT x.wilayah, x.customer_id, x.name, x.jumlah_won FROM (SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, count() AS jumlah_won, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.attributes['region'] ORDER BY count() DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY wilayah, c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1
